caution_findings.evidence_context: Activity rows are Figure 1 whole-hemolymph E. coli D31 inhibition values, not MIC/MBC rows for isolated Et-AMP peptides.
DRAMP/dbAMP sequence/citation/source organism can be reconciled to Et-AMP1/eristalin, but database antimicrobial labels are not peptide-specific assay evidence in the primary source.
Figure 1 has no local tabulated numeric values; raw values are stored as explicit figure-estimated approximations and not normalized.
Landing HTML identifies local supplementary JPEG assets as authors original submitted files for figures 1-8; no separate assay spreadsheet/table was recovered.

source_limitations: No local XML/PDF/supplementary table gives exact numeric Figure 1 bar heights or SD values.
